about: Aether's public networks, as every client names them: --network in agentmcp (wallet/network.go), network in the TypeScript (src/networks.ts) and Python (aether_client/networks.py) clients. Endpoints are empty where none is published yet. On mainnet the USDC path is empty until the Injective channel is opened and listed after launch; a path given alone is then Circle's USDC on Injective over it (usdcWith). Checked by wallet/network_test.go, test/networks.test.ts and tests/test_networks.py.

usdcWith.name: mainnet, nothing given: no USDC yet
mainnet, a path alone: Circle's USDC on Injective over it
